messages.subject: featureCounts parameters: −− fracOverlap −− fracOverlapFeature + recuwest for a parameter
parts:
Hello
 I have problem with the parameters −− fracOverlap −− fracOverlapFeature, there is either a bug or I do not understand them properly:

I have sam file:
@HD    VN:1.0    SO:coordinate
@SQ    SN:NC_000913.2    LN:4639675
@RG    ID:N1_phred64_gap100
@PG    ID:bowtie2    PN:bowtie2    VN:2.0.0-beta7
FCC4RN3ACXX:8:1101:13114:2637#GTAGAGAT    0    NC_000913.2    104715    255    27M    *    0    0    ACGCCTTTGGCACGCCGCCAAGCGACG    FGEJIIGGJIIIJJJJJJJJIIGHGHH    AS:i:0    XN:i:0    XM:i:0    XO:i:0    XG:i:0    NM:i:0    MD:Z:27    YT:Z:CP    RG:Z:N1_phred64_gap100    NH:i:1

I have SAF file:
Geneid    Chr    Start    End    Strand    Length
FM_+NC_000913.2_104718_23    NC_000913.2    104719    104741    +

I use command:
~/subread/subread-1.6.0-Linux-x86_64/bin/featureCounts -T 1 -M -O -s 1 -F SAF -R SAM --fracOverlap 0.888 --fracOverlapFeature 0.888 -a 1.SAF -o 1_counted.SAF 1.sam

For example:
I would like to set that the read and the feature can be different by two bases:
in that case my read and feature woulnd not match.


Best,
Hannes

messages.author: bce99ba71cd48eea
messages.subject: Re: featureCounts parameters: −− fracOverlap −− fracOverlapFeature + recuwest for a parameter
parts:
Dear Hannes,

This is because of the round-up error when converting a float number to a integer. In other words, the algorithm works in this way:

1) calculate the effective read length (27 in your case)
2) calculate the minimum threshold to the # of overlapping bases in read (27 * 0.888 = 23.98; int(23.98) = 23)
3) compare the threshold (23) with the actual # of overlapping bases (23).

I calculated the threshold first because floating number operations are usually slow, so I only calculate it once for each read/read-pair. It would be a very little slower if I calculate the fractions of bases for each overlapping exon, and compare the fractions with the required fraction.
set overlap not by the fraction but number of bases which could be missing

Thanks for your suggestion. It seems that this is particularly useful when the read lengths are variable, if I'm right?

Cheers,
Yang

messages.author: bed8cc3df5933534
messages.subject: Re: featureCounts parameters: −− fracOverlap −− fracOverlapFeature + recuwest for a parameter
parts:
But isn't that counterintuitive?
For example Bedtools intersect does not count this read. It is rounding up the minimum threshold.

I guess it is now too late to change it but perhaps it would be good idea to mention it in documentation.
*
"It seems that this is particularly useful when the read lengths are variable, if I'm right?"

Yes. I have reads with variable lengths and what I do now is that I sort features by their length and run counting with with separate parameters.
This feature would save time and make life easier in situations like this.
